A real photography workflow

From idea to review,
all in one workspace

Built around the way photographers actually work: define the brief and references first, then turn them into shots, gear, schedules, and on-set actions.

  1. BriefDefine goals, audience, and deliverables
  2. ReferencesCollect inspiration with source and license records
  3. PlanArrange shots, gear, direction, and lighting
  4. ScheduleSchedule time, camera positions, and resources
  5. ShootCheck off shots, take notes, and flag pickups on set
  6. ReviewCarry proven decisions into the next production

Data and privacy

Three data modes, built around your workflow

PhotoAtelier provides tools and open templates. One person’s private library never becomes another person’s default asset source.

01

Public demo

Explore with open sample assets that ship with clear source labels.

  • Does not connect to local folders
  • Data stays in the current browser
  • Does not use private Obsidian content

02

Connect your own library

Use the local connector to index photos, notes, and attachments on your device.

  • Each person connects their own folders
  • Original images remain on the device
  • Only required metadata is indexed

03

Private local mode

For private work: local execution, offline access, and full user control.

  • Libraries and notes are never shared
  • Sync credentials are never exposed
  • Import and export independently
Open asset sources Pexels Wikimedia Commons Always verify licensing and attribution on the original source page
